'''Venner''' was a middle-aged [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member who worked as an orderly in the infirmary on one of the Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safeworlds]]. He was present when the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Saras (Imperial Intelligence)|Saras]] was exposed.<ref name="Strongholds" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Venner appears in the opening story for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''.<ref name="Strongholds" />
